title: Files
subtitle: {{name}} · its own folder
offline: The Machine is offline. You can change this once it is back.

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: The Machine may not have listed its Agents yet, or this Agent is gone.

older.title: This Machine cannot give folders yet
older.body: Update the Runtime on the Machine first, then the Agent can read folders you pick on it.

selected.title: Read selected folders on the Machine
selected.footer: The Agent reads and writes only its own Workdir now. Turn this on to let it read a project already on the Machine, such as ~/code/shop, without cloning it again (ADR 0087).
selected.warning: The Agent reads every file in the folders you pick and can send them out through its Egress. The home folder, .ssh, browser data and system folders can never be picked.

folders.heading: Folders it reads
folders.footer: Enter the full path of a folder on the Machine. The Machine checks that it exists and is not where secrets are kept.
folders.emptyDetail: The Agent still reads only its own Workdir.

invalid.title: Not a full path
invalid.body: Enter a full path starting with /, such as /Users/me/code/shop.

authenticate.open: Let {{name}} read selected folders on the Machine
authenticate.close: Keep {{name}} to its own folder again
